title: Microsoft To Do
description: Task lists, tasks and linked resources in Microsoft To Do (Microsoft Graph)

fields.label: Tenant ID
fields.help: Directory (tenant) GUID or a verified domain such as contoso.onmicrosoft.com.

operations.title: Get a task
operations.path: /{{ p.userTarget | rl | then:'users' | default:'me' }}{{ p.userTarget | rl | then:'/' }}{{ p.userTarget | rl }}/todo/lists/{{ p.taskListId }}/tasks/{{ p.taskId }}

fields.label: User (app-only)
fields.help: Only with an Entra app connection: the user's principal name or object ID whose To Do to use. Leave empty for your own account.
